history_note: T0030 through T0033 are PRESERVED unchanged. This receipt records three corrections to what T0033 delivered and claimed.

corrections.claim_in_T0033: tenant scoping on every read and before every decision: another site's posting is 404, and nothing is written
corrections.what_was_actually_true: Every financial query filtered on tenant_id ALONE. The test that was supposed to cover this gave each fixture a fresh tenant AND a fresh site, so it exercised cross-TENANT isolation only and would have passed unchanged while leaking between two sites of the SAME tenant -- which is exactly how a multi-property customer is arranged. The claim was stronger than its evidence.
corrections.correction: Every path now filters tenant_id AND site_id: queue, posting detail, pinned evidence, attempts, review history, the ownership pre-check and the decision itself. A new test builds TWO SITES UNDER ONE TENANT and asserts the queue does not leak, the detail is 404, the decision is 404 with no ledger row, and that the out-of-scope 404 is byte-identical to a genuinely absent posting so the API does not confirm existence.
corrections.test_proved_bidirectional: The new test was verified to FAIL against the previous tenant-only query ('the queue LEAKED a posting owned by another site of the same tenant') before being trusted, and to pass once the scope was corrected.

corrections.what_was_actually_true: The endpoint accepted any non-empty JSON object and persisted it verbatim in the append-only review ledger. That satisfied section 15's mandatory-evidence rule and violated section 11's prohibition on secrets, credentials, card data and raw PMS material in audit payloads. An immutable ledger is the worst possible place to discover a secret, because it cannot be redacted afterwards.
corrections.correction: Evidence is now a CLOSED, BOUNDED, STRUCTURED shape: source_type from a fixed allowlist of seven documented sources, a bounded reference identifying the external artefact, a bounded single-line note, and an optional RFC3339 verified_at. The API refuses anything shaped like a credential keyword, key/token literal, card number, CVV reference, raw FIAS frame or raw JSON/XML payload, plus control characters, multi-line text and over-length fields. Fourteen adversarial cases are covered and each additionally asserts that the refused evidence reached NO ledger row. The canonical stored shape is asserted on the positive path.

corrections.claim_in_T0033: READ for hotel_it_manager / front_office_operator / guest_relations_operator / site_viewer
corrections.what_was_actually_true: guest_relations_operator was NEVER granted financial-review in the code, and Contract section 15 does not list Guest Relations among the financial roles at all. The receipt's prose was wrong; the code was right.
corrections.correction: The documentation is corrected to the approved model and NOTHING was broadened to match the stale prose. The delivered matrix is payments_operator WRITE (section 15), site_admin implicit, and READ for hotel_it_manager, front_office_operator and site_viewer.

corrections.what_was_actually_true: The Plan header said the Manual Review backend/RBAC/step-up API was delivered while its own WS-F row still said those components were open.
corrections.correction: The WS-F row now states BACKEND COMPLETE with the frontend open, and names the files that implement it.
